chunk: standard: derived (OAGIS 10.x Invoice with education-specific extensions)
standardBody: Open Applications Group (OAGi) + education-sector extensions

deviations:
  - K-12 district as bill-to party (not a commercial customer)
  - Fiscal year offset (publisher April 1 FY vs district June 30 FY) affects date semantics
  - Line items reference ISBNs (state-specific regional identifiers) not generic product codes
  - Invoice creation trigger is Agreement approval (Salesforce), not PO receipt directly

description: >
  Canonical invoice model for K-12 educational publishers integrating billing between
  Salesforce (Agreement object) and QuickBooks (Invoice). Designed for the agreement-to-invoice
  flow where a Salesforce Agreement Closed Won event triggers QuickBooks invoice creation.

required:
  - invoiceId
  - externalId
  - billToDistrictId
  - billToDistrictName
  - agreementId
  - invoiceDate
  - dueDate
  - totalAmount
  - lineItems
  - status

properties:
  invoiceId:
    type: string
    description: QuickBooks Invoice ID (server-generated; null at creation time)
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  externalId:
    type: string
    description: External ID for idempotent upsert — QB_InvoiceId__c on Salesforce Agreement
    sourceSystem: both
  billToDistrictId:
    type: string
    description: Salesforce Account ID for the school district
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  billToDistrictName:
    type: string
    description: District name — must match QuickBooks Customer name exactly for UC1 lookup
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  agreementId:
    type: string
    description: Salesforce Agreement object ID that triggered invoice creation
    sourceSystem: Salesforce
  invoiceDate:
    type: string
    format: date
    description: Invoice creation date (ISO 8601)
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  dueDate:
    type: string
    format: date
    description: Payment due date
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  totalAmount:
    type: number
    description: Total invoice amount (USD)
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  openBalance:
    type: number
    description: Unpaid balance — synced back to Salesforce Agreement via UC2
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  paymentDate:
    type: string
    format: date
    description: Date payment received — synced back to Salesforce Agreement via UC2
    sourceSystem: QuickBooks
  status:
    type: string
    enum: [DRAFT, PENDING, SENT, PAID, OVERDUE, VOIDED]
    description: Invoice lifecycle status
